title: Hotels Near BNH Hospital, Bangkok 2026 — 7 Closest Stays + Booking Links | ThailandAddict
metaDesc: The 7 closest hotels to BNH Hospital in Bangkok — each with the real walking or driving distance to BNH, what it's best for, approximate starting prices and booking links. Made for patients and their families.
ogDesc: The 7 closest stays to BNH, with real distances and prices.
intro: BNH sits on Convent Road, a short connector between Silom and Sathorn in the heart of the business district. The upside: the area is packed with places to stay, from budget guesthouses to 5-star hotels, and it is an easy walk from BTS Sala Daeng or MRT Si Lom. Below we list only hotels you can genuinely walk to the hospital from, ordered cheapest to priciest, each with its real distance to BNH so patient families and check-up visitors can pick by budget and convenience.

blocks.html: Short answer: The easiest walks to BNH are the hotels right on Convent Road or Saladaeng Soi — Le Siam sits at 3 Convent Rd, a few steps from the hospital, while Artino and Mirth Sathorn are about a 5–6 minute walk. For a full 5-star stay, pick Pullman Bangkok Hotel G on Silom Road (about a 10-minute walk). All are close to BTS Sala Daeng / MRT Si Lom.

blocks.text: Hotels near BNH, by distance & budget

items.name: The Inn Saladaeng
items.meta: 📍 8-min walk (650 m) to BNH · ★ 3-star · Best for: Budget · close to BTS Sala Daeng · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: A small budget hotel on Saladaeng Soi, a 3-minute walk to BTS Sala Daeng and MRT Si Lom, then a turn onto Convent Road to reach BNH. Rooms are simple but clean with a fridge and safe — good for check-up visitors who want to keep costs down and don't mind a slightly longer walk.

items.name: Mirth Sathorn Hotel
items.meta: 📍 6-min walk (450 m) to BNH · ★ 3-star · Best for: Patient families · walk to the hospital · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: A small boutique hotel on Sathorn Soi 4, about 450 m from BNH — an easy walk under 10 minutes. Rooms have a warm, homey feel with a 24-hour front desk and in-room safe, and the price is very friendly. A good fit for families staying several nights without paying big-hotel rates.

items.name: Urbana Sathorn
items.meta: 📍 8-min walk (700 m) to BNH · ★ 4-star · Best for: Longer stays · kitchenette rooms · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: An apartment-style hotel in Sathorn, about an 8-minute walk to BNH through Soi Convent. Rooms are suites with a kitchenette, a full-size fridge, and a washer in some units — ideal if you're caring for a patient over several days and want to cook or keep medication chilled. There's a pool and gym to unwind between hospital visits.

items.name: Artino Hotel Silom
items.meta: 📍 5-min walk (400 m) to BNH · ★ 4-star · Best for: Very close to BNH · quiet boutique · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: An 18-room boutique hotel only about 400 m from BNH — roughly a 5-minute walk. Rooms are clean and more spacious than the price suggests, with a rooftop pool and parking. Reviews praise the location and the staff. A solid pick if you want to be very close to the hospital but still keep a quiet setting.

items.name: Le Siam Hotel Silom by PCL
items.meta: 📍 3-min walk (250 m) to BNH · ★ 3-star · Best for: Right on Convent Rd · closest · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: Sits at 3 Convent Road, the same street as BNH, just about a 3-minute walk to the hospital — the closest on this list. It's an older, well-kept hotel with an outdoor pool and a restaurant, and you step out into a street full of eateries and convenience stores. The best choice if you'll be walking to and from the hospital often.

items.name: PASSA Hotel Bangkok
items.meta: 📍 7-min walk (550 m) to BNH · ★ 4-star · Best for: Stylish design · rooftop pool · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: A design-forward hotel on Saladaeng Soi 2 with bold murals and a rooftop pool overlooking the city, about 550 m from BNH — roughly a 7-minute walk. Review scores are very high (close to 9 out of 10) for both cleanliness and location. A good match if you're here for a check-up and also want a stylish room to relax in.

items.name: Pullman Bangkok Hotel G
items.meta: 📍 10-min walk (800 m) to BNH · ★ 5-star · Best for: Full 5-star · full service · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: A 469-room 5-star hotel on Silom Road with modern, floor-to-ceiling-glass rooms and several restaurants, including a Michelin Guide pick. It's about 800 m to BNH on foot, or a few minutes by taxi. The best option if you're travelling as a family and want full service, a big pool, a gym, and a comfortable room after a long day at the hospital.

faq.q: Which hotel is the closest walk to BNH?
faq.a: Le Siam Hotel at 3 Convent Road is the closest, about a 3-minute walk to BNH since it's on the same street. Next closest are Artino Hotel Silom (about 5 minutes) and Mirth Sathorn (about 6 minutes).

faq.q: Can I reach BNH from the train stations?
faq.a: Yes. BNH is about a 5–7 minute walk from BTS Sala Daeng (Exit 2) and MRT Si Lom, via Convent Road. Most hotels on this list sit between the stations and the hospital, so walking is easy throughout the day.

faq.q: For several nights caring for a patient, which should I pick?
faq.a: For a long stay where you want to cook or keep medication chilled, pick Urbana Sathorn with its in-room kitchenette. For budget plus proximity, Mirth Sathorn or The Inn Saladaeng give better value, while Pullman Bangkok Hotel G is the choice if you want full service for the whole family.
